messages:
Anya: kicking off a small canary for starlight-v2 in eu1 — 30m change window, 5% traffic. Draft release notes here: https://docs/internal/releases/starlight-v2
Sam: ack. i'll keep an eye on latency dashboards and traces. start at 5% makes sense.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary started: model=starlight-v2 region=eu1 traffic=5% window=30m ticket=#1234
Leo: quick Q — what's the planned fallback ordering if we see memory OOMs or perf regressions? need to confirm for on-call.
Anya: fallback order: starlight-v1-quant -> starlight-v1-full -> default-generic. enterprise pinned versions should remain pinned for dedicated tenants.
Katie: proposing rollback thresholds: p95 latency increase >50% sustained for 10m OR error rate >1% sustained for 10m. ops team to vote rollback if threshold hit.
Sam: first 7m looks clean, p95 +3%, errors 0.1%. hooking up request sampling to traces.
Miriam: ops here. ready to call rollback per thresholds. Also flag — need opt-out blurb in release notes for dedicated customers who require pinning info.
Anya: will add opt-out note and the fallback ordering to the release notes now. @DeployBot, can you annotate the deploy timeline for the notes?
DeployBot: [deploybot] Annotated timeline: canary_start=1818181818, canary_checkpoints=[+10m,+20m], promote_plan=conditional. Link: /deploy/1818181818
Leo: added a short doc snippet for fallback rationale: why quant fallback first (latency + mem tradeoff). https://infra.internal/fallbacks/starlight
Sam: telemetry alert set: p95_threshold=baseline*1.5, error_rate_threshold=1%. I'll be on pager for the next 2h.
DeployBot: Canary metrics @ +10m: p95_delta=+5%, error_rate=0.2%, throughput stable.
Miriam: thumbs up from ops. still within thresholds.
Anya: plan: if still healthy at +20m bump to 20% for 15m then evaluate for full rollout. anyone object?
Leo: no objections. suggest we call an immediate rollback if any OOMs show up in the quant variant — that's the main risk.
Katie: agreed. I'll log the rollback decision criteria in the ticket and update the release notes with change window and rollback vote instructions.
Sam: noting: we'll post final release note summary to #announcements after full cutover and include rollback timeline in the ticket.
DeployBot: Canary complete: no rollback triggered. Proceeding to gradual rollout step: target=20% for 15m. status=ok
Miriam: ops ready to supervise the 20% step. i'll be on-call and will escalate if any threshold breaches.
Anya: thanks team — filing post-deploy checklist entries and updating release notes: 'Starlight v2: improvements for long-sequence latency. Fallback order and rollback thresholds documented. Change window: 30m canary + staged ramp.'
Sam: nice work. i'll prep the incident hooks and evals monitor for the full rollout.
Leo: added a small snippet to the docs about how the fallback priority map is resolved at runtime.
Katie: posting a short note to customers with dedicated capacity about optional pinning procedure.
Anya: closing thread for the canary. will open follow-up if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
